dedupe_keys.name: national health services directory nhsd australia national directory of health services and practitioners with fhir apis

description: The National Health Services Directory is Australia's national directory of health services and practitioners, funded by the Australian governments and managed by Healthdirect Australia as core national digital health infrastructure under the Intergovernmental Agreement on National Digital Health. It aggregates health service information from more than 25 data sharing partners and service providers, covering about 150,000 health services with their locations, opening hours, service types, practitioners and secure messaging endpoints, and it is searched more than 2.2 million times a month. The data model follows the FHIR Australian Provider Directory standard and uses SNOMED CT-AU terms. Coverage is national. Consumers search it through the Healthdirect Service Finder, and organisations integrate through standards-based FHIR APIs and widgets documented in the Developer and Integration Hub; data are provided free of charge to integration partners, who must apply and agree to terms. Caveats: bulk data are not published as open files, access requires an integration agreement, and completeness depends on providers keeping their listings current. Simulation uses: locating health services and their opening hours for accessibility and surge analyses, and mapping primary care alternatives when hospitals are disrupted. Related records: healthsites.io (data-healthsites-io) is an open global facility map and the Dartmouth Atlas data (data-dartmouth-atlas-hospital-service-areas-and-rates) give US healthcare geography.
